aiExplanation.summary: This file registers the Notes webview commands and keeps toolbar mode changes synchronized with the active resource.
aiExplanation.detail:
- registerNotesUi: Registers Notes commands, reloads the active resource when returning to Detail, and loads Navigator data when entering Navigator.
- getErrorMessage: Converts command failures into readable warnings.
- selectWorkspaceFolder: Resolves the workspace used for Project Notes.
